mapper.select: select fundId, finprodName, serialNo, interType, xmlStatus, checkStatus, valDate from (SELECT BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID fundId, BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME finprodName, SIV.SERIALNO serialNo, '1' interType, DECODE(SIV.XML_STATUS, null, 0, SIV.XML_STATUS) xmlStatus, DECODE(SIV.CHECK_STATUS, null, 0, SIV.CHECK_STATUS) checkStatus, TO_CHAR(BVTD.VAL_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd') valDate FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.BOOKSET_ID, A.VAL_DATE FROM BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA A) BVTD LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BB ON BVTD.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID AND BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = 'F16' LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO BASI ON BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = 'F16' LEFT JOIN SZT_INTERF_VALUATION SIV ON SIV.FINPROD_ID = BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND SIV.INTER_TYPE = '1' AND SIV.CDATE = TO_CHAR(BVTD.VAL_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')) where 1 = 1 and fundId = #{fundId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and valDate = to_char(to_date(#{valDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'yyyyMMdd') and xmlStatus = #{xmlStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and checkStatus = #{checkStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
